chunks: The sky will cleave asunder, and on that day it will be weak.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the sky on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir highlights the absolute subjugation of the celestial spheres to Allah's will, serving as a sign for the resurrection. The term 'wahiyah' (weak/fragile) underscores that the stability of the universe is contingent, not inherent, pointing to the ultimate authority of the Divine. This cosmic dissolution mirrors the spiritual awakening expected of believers, reinforcing the reality of the Hereafter.
